paragraphs.notes: Heading of numbered step 2. Unlike the headings at [0040] and [0044] it does NOT end in 的合成 ('synthesis of'); [0048] likewise omits it. Printed with justification spaces around the hyphens (2- 氯 -3- 乙酰基 -6- 甲磺酰基甲苯); those spaces are layout artifacts of the scan and have been removed here. The hyphens are half-width '-' as printed. The example number itself (实施例 N) is not printed on this page.
Marker carries no text. It introduces the structure drawn immediately below it (drawing 1).

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器，温度计和回流冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中加入2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯34.0g(0.2mol)、无水三氯化铝40.5g(0.3mol)和二氯甲烷，在15-20℃温度条件下，滴加乙酰氯23.5g(0.3mol)，滴加完毕后，在室温继续反应5h，反应完毕，将反应物倒入冰水和盐酸的混合物中，分出有机层，水层用二氯甲烷萃取，合并有机层，水洗，浓缩得白色固体2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯36.5g，收率86％，熔点110-112℃。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene 34.0 g (0.2 mol), anhydrous aluminium trichloride 40.5 g (0.3 mol) and dichloromethane; at a temperature of 15-20°C, acetyl chloride 23.5 g (0.3 mol) was added dropwise; after the addition was complete, the reaction was continued at room temperature for 5 h; when the reaction was complete, the reaction mixture was poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid, the organic layer was separated, the aqueous layer was extracted with dichloromethane, the organic layers were combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 36.5 g of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene as a white solid, yield 86％, melting point 110-112°C.
paragraphs.notes: TYPEFACE CAVEAT (applies to this whole page): the serif face used renders lowercase 'l' with a shape indistinguishable from the digit '1'. '500ml', '0.2mol', '0.3mol', '200ml', '100ml', '250ml' are printed with that glyph and are read here as 'l'; the surrounding units make the reading unambiguous. STOICHIOMETRY: 34.0 g stated as 0.2 mol implies M = 170.0 g/mol, but the drawn and named 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene is C8H9ClO2S, M = 204.7. 170.2 is the molar mass of the DES-CHLORO analogue, 2-methylphenyl methyl sulfone / 6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene C8H10O2S. See discrepancies. The two non-aromatic reagents do check out: AlCl3 40.5 g / 0.3 mol = 135 vs 133.3 actual; acetyl chloride 23.5 g / 0.3 mol = 78.3 vs 78.5 actual. The stated 86％ yield is exact on the des-chloro basis (36.5 g / 212.3 g/mol = 0.172 mol = 86.0% of 0.2 mol) and is 74% on the chlorinated basis.

Printed as 'CDC1' followed by a SUBSCRIPT 3 - the 'l' of CDCl3 rendered in the digit-one-like glyph. Read as CDCl3. Two defects are printed as-is and not corrected: '2.64(s,3H,)' has an empty assignment after the second comma, and the last peak reads '8.10(d,H)' with no proton count before H where every other entry gives '1H'. The line terminates with a half-width period '.', unlike [0043] and [0047] which end with the full-width 。. Punctuation widths: the colon is full-width '：' (the gap following it is about twice that following the half-width periods in '2.64'); the commas and parentheses on this line are half-width. Three methyl singlets (2.64, 2.88, 3.14) are consistent with the three CH3 environments of the drawn structure (acetyl CH3, ring CH3, SO2CH3).

paragraphs.zh: 3、2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Heading of numbered step 3. Justification spaces around the hyphens removed as above.
Marker carries no text. It introduces the structure drawn immediately below it (drawing 2).

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器和回流冷凝管的500ml的四口反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯50.88g(0.24mol)和200ml四氢呋喃溶液，在室温下滴加15％的次氯酸钠溶液500g，滴加完毕，升温回流5h，反应完后加入100ml水，蒸除溶剂，冷却，加入盐酸酸化析出固体，过滤，用乙醇重结晶，水洗，干燥得白色固体82g，收率72％，熔点230-233℃。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene 50.88 g (0.24 mol) and 200 ml of tetrahydrofuran solution; at room temperature 500 g of 15％ sodium hypochlorite solution was added dropwise; after the addition was complete the mixture was heated to reflux for 5 h; after the reaction was over 100 ml of water was added, the solvent was distilled off, the mixture was cooled, hydrochloric acid was added to acidify and precipitate a solid, which was filtered, recrystallised from ethanol, washed with water and dried to give 82 g of a white solid, yield 72％, melting point 230-233°C.
paragraphs.notes: Printed 反应完后 (not 反应完毕) here. STOICHIOMETRY: 50.88 g stated as 0.24 mol implies M = 212.0 g/mol; the drawn and named 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene is C10H11ClO3S, M = 246.7, while the des-chloro analogue C10H12O3S is 212.3 - the same des-chloro pattern as [0038]. Separately, the 82 g product mass cannot be reconciled with the 72％ yield printed alongside it on ANY molar mass: 0.24 mol x 72% = 0.1728 mol, so 82 g would require M = 474 g/mol, against 248.7 for the chlorinated acid and 214.2 for the des-chloro acid. 72％ of 0.24 mol corresponds to 37.0 g on the des-chloro basis. Recorded as printed; no correction inferred. Hypochlorite charge checks out as a haloform oxidation: 500 g of 15％ NaOCl = 75 g = 1.01 mol = 4.2 equiv on 0.24 mol.

Printed here as 'CDC13' with the 3 INLINE (no subscript), unlike [0039] where the 3 is a subscript. Both read as CDCl3; the typographic difference is recorded rather than normalised silently. Two methyl singlets match the two CH3 environments of the drawn acid (ring CH3, SO2CH3); no COOH proton is reported. Line ends with the full-width 。.

paragraphs.zh: 4、2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成

paragraphs.notes: Marker carries no text. It introduces the structure drawn immediately below it (drawing 3).

paragraphs.zh: 在250ml的四口反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸42.8g(0.2mol)，对甲苯磺酸0.5g和200ml甲醇，加热回流搅拌10h，反应完毕，冷却，减压蒸出甲醇，冷却析出固体，用乙醇重结晶，得白色固体44.2g，收率97％，熔点105-107℃。
paragraphs.en: Into a 250 ml four-necked reaction flask were charged 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid 42.8 g (0.2 mol), p-toluenesulfonic acid 0.5 g and 200 ml of methanol; the mixture was heated at reflux with stirring for 10 h; when the reaction was complete it was cooled, the methanol was distilled off under reduced pressure, a solid separated on cooling, which was recrystallised from ethanol to give 44.2 g of a white solid, yield 97％, melting point 105-107°C.
paragraphs.notes: STOICHIOMETRY: 42.8 g stated as 0.2 mol implies M = 214.0 g/mol; the drawn and named 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid is C9H9ClO4S, M = 248.7, while the des-chloro analogue C9H10O4S is 214.2 - the same pattern again. The stated 97％ yield is exact on the des-chloro basis (44.2 g / 228.3 g/mol = 0.194 mol = 96.8% of 0.2 mol) and is 84% on the chlorinated basis.

No δ symbol before (ppm) on this line, unlike [0039] and [0043]. Printed as-is. Three methyl singlets match the three CH3 environments of the drawn methyl ester (ring CH3, SO2CH3, OCH3 at 4.01). Solvent switches to DMSO here.

paragraphs.zh: 5、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯
paragraphs.notes: Heading of numbered step 5. Like [0036] it omits 的合成. The body text and the structure for step 5 do not appear on this page; the page ends at [0049].
Last marker on the page. Carries no text and no drawing follows it on this page - the structure it introduces falls on the next page (p08). Nothing between [0049] and the page number 7 in the footer.

structures.core: benzene, drawn as a hexagon with vertical left and right edges and an apex at top and bottom; three Kekule double bonds drawn as inner lines
substituents: C(=O)CH3 (acetyl, drawn as CH3-C with a double bond up to O) at C1, the upper-left ring vertex
Cl at C2, the top apex vertex
CH3 at C3, the upper-right ring vertex
SO2CH3 at C4, the lower-right ring vertex
H (unsubstituted) at C5, the bottom apex vertex
H (unsubstituted) at C6, the lower-left ring vertex
structures.name: 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrows, no reagents drawn. Numbering used above is read off the drawing with C1 = the ring carbon bearing the left-hand acyl group, proceeding around the ring through the chlorine. The four substituents are on four CONSECUTIVE ring carbons: acetyl adjacent to Cl, Cl adjacent to CH3, CH3 adjacent to SO2CH3, with the remaining two ring carbons unsubstituted. Under the text's toluene-based numbering (CH3 = C1) this is exactly 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene: from CH3 at C1, Cl at C2, acetyl at C3, and SO2CH3 at C6 going the other way round the ring. Drawing and the name written in [0036] and [0038] agree. PRESENTED AS: product of numbered step 2 of the invention's own worked example, NOT prior art. There is no background/prior-art scheme anywhere on this page.

substituents: COOH (drawn as HO-C with a double bond up to O) at C1, the upper-left ring vertex
Cl at C2, the top apex vertex
CH3 at C3, the upper-right ring vertex
SO2CH3 at C4, the lower-right ring vertex
H (unsubstituted) at C5, the bottom apex vertex

structures.name: 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrows, no reagents drawn. Identical to drawing 1 except that the acetyl group is replaced by a carboxyl group - consistent with the haloform oxidation described in [0042]. Here C1 (the carboxyl carbon's ring attachment) is also C1 under the text's benzoic-acid numbering, so the drawn positions and the name in [0040]/[0042] agree directly: Cl at C2, CH3 at C3, SO2CH3 at C4. PRESENTED AS: product of numbered step 3 of the invention's own worked example, NOT prior art.

Cl at C2, the top apex vertex

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrows, no reagents drawn. The ester is drawn explicitly as CH3-O attached to the carbonyl carbon (label reads CH3O with the O bonded to C), so it is unambiguously a methyl ester and not a free acid. Agrees with the name in [0044]/[0046]. PRESENTED AS: product of numbered step 4 of the invention's own worked example, NOT prior art.

discrepancies.what: Every aromatic mass/mole pair in the prose corresponds to the DES-CHLORO analogue of the structure actually drawn, i.e. the arithmetic behaves as if the ring chlorine were a hydrogen. The offset is the same in all three steps and equals the Cl-for-H substitution (34.4 g/mol).
discrepancies.drawing_says: All three drawn structures carry Cl on the ring. Chlorinated molar masses: 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene C8H9ClO2S = 204.7; 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene C10H11ClO3S = 246.7; 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid C9H9ClO4S = 248.7; methyl ester C10H11ClO4S = 262.7.
discrepancies.text_says: [0038] 34.0g = 0.2mol implies 170.0. [0042] 50.88g = 0.24mol implies 212.0. [0046] 42.8g = 0.2mol implies 214.0. The des-chloro molar masses are 170.2, 212.3 and 214.2 respectively - exact matches. The stated yields close exactly on the same des-chloro basis: [0038] 36.5g/212.3 = 0.172mol = 86.0% vs 收率86％ printed; [0046] 44.2g/228.3 = 0.194mol = 96.8% vs 收率97％ printed. On the chlorinated masses the same yields would be 74% and 84%. By contrast the two non-aromatic reagents in [0038] are correct as printed (AlCl3 40.5g/0.3mol = 135 vs 133.3 actual; acetyl chloride 23.5g/0.3mol = 78.3 vs 78.5 actual), so the error is confined to the chlorinated aromatic substrates.

discrepancies.what: In step 3 the isolated product mass cannot be reconciled with the yield printed in the same sentence, on either candidate molar mass. This is separate from and larger than the des-chloro issue above.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Product drawn is 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid, M = 248.7 (des-chloro analogue M = 214.2).
discrepancies.text_says: [0042]: 0.24 mol of substrate, 干燥得白色固体82g, 收率72％. 0.24 x 0.72 = 0.1728 mol, so 82 g would require M = 474 g/mol. A 72％ yield corresponds to 43.0 g on the chlorinated basis or 37.0 g on the des-chloro basis. The figure is transcribed as printed (82g, verified at high magnification); no corrected value is inferred here.

discrepancies.what: The parent hydride used for numbering changes between steps, so the same drawn skeleton carries different locants in different paragraphs. This is a nomenclature change and NOT a structural contradiction - flagged so downstream passes do not treat it as one.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Drawings 1, 2 and 3 have identical ring skeletons and identical substitution patterns; only the group at the upper-left vertex changes (acetyl -> COOH -> COOCH3).
discrepancies.text_says: [0036]/[0038] number the ring as a TOLUENE (CH3 = C1, Cl = C2, acetyl = C3, SO2CH3 = C6), while [0040] onward number it as a BENZOIC ACID (COOH = C1, Cl = C2, CH3 = C3, SO2CH3 = C4). Both descriptions map onto the same drawn arrangement, so the two naming systems are mutually consistent.

discrepancies.what: The NMR list in [0039] contains two printing defects.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The drawn structure has three distinct CH3 environments (acetyl CH3, ring CH3, SO2CH3) plus two adjacent aromatic H, matching three singlets and two doublets.
discrepancies.text_says: [0039] prints '2.64(s,3H,)' with an empty assignment field after the second comma, and '8.10(d,H)' with the proton count missing before H where every other entry prints '1H'. Both transcribed verbatim.

discrepancies.what: The deuterated-solvent label is typeset two different ways on the same page.
discrepancies.text_says: [0039] prints CDC1 with a SUBSCRIPT 3; [0043] prints CDC13 with the 3 INLINE. Both read as CDCl3. The 'l' is rendered in a glyph indistinguishable from the digit 1 throughout this typeface, which also affects 500ml / 0.2mol / 200ml / 100ml / 250ml.
